lines: A Seal. On my kitchen table. Well.
Your father got his first one at nineteen and never once shut up about it.
You have until the kettle boils. Then I want all of it.
Let me look at it again. Go on.
It is watching me back. I do not think I will ever get used to that.
Eat something that is not dried fish, {name}. That is the whole of my advice.
There you are. I have unpacked exactly two boxes and I am calling that a day.
Dr. Vess came by at dawn asking for you. At DAWN.
Go on. The station is the big one with the charts in the window.
You've been out to the coast. Then you can tell me something.
Well's been dry four weeks and there's no drought. Ask anyone.
Something is holding the water somewhere. It isn't holding it here.
A Seal already. Don't tell Ollet, he'll get competitive on Perrin's behalf.
Listen. The well's stopped humming. Three nights now, nothing at all.
I thought that would be a relief. It isn't.
So Vess gave you one after all. Look at the size of it.
Do me a favour on your way out. Stand by the well a minute and just listen.
Then come back and tell me I'm not going soft. Nobody else in this town will.
New face. You're the family that took the Corrin place, aren't you.
Fair warning: that well hums some nights. Everyone tells me it's the pipes.
It isn't the pipes.
You've GOT one. Can I see it? Can I hold it? Can I name it?
...Fine. But I'm putting it in my book anyway and I'm spelling it how I like.
I can name every kin on Route 1. Go on, test me.
...I can name four kin on Route 1.
The fifth one just screams and leaves. You try writing that down.

mh_hiker: Ledges. Best thing in this region and nobody appreciates them.
Drop down one heading south and you save yourself an hour of walking.
Try climbing back UP one and you learn something about yourself. I've learned it twice.

lines: Gone, is he. Didn't take the lunch I packed him either.
His mother keeps a Bastion two provinces off. He's decided that's a debt.
It isn't. Tell him that somewhere I'm not standing. He might hear it from you.
Perrin hasn't sat down since Vess sent word. Wore a line in my floor.
Two starters, two candidates, and my child has decided that's a duel.
Try not to let it be a duel. That's all I'm asking. Try.
So that's what you went with.
Huh. Not what I'd have taken. Which means beating you will actually count.
Don't look at me like that, I'm being nice.
You're the new one. Good. I was worried Vess would hand me both of them.
That was a joke. Mostly.
Go and pick. I'll wait. I'm excellent at waiting, ask my father.
You've met Kerrow. I can tell. People go quiet in a particular way afterwards.
She isn't lying to you. That's the difficult part. She never has been.
Keep the Vellum open. Facts first. Sides afterwards, if you must.
Still here? Sit. No, don't, you'll only fidget and I'll watch you do it.
Keep the Vellum open and keep your eyes up.
Anything that is where it shouldn't be, I want to know. Especially the dull ones.
You came. Good. Sit, don't sit, whichever gets you talking faster.
I study movement. Not battling, not breeding. Movement.
And something in the Hollow Sea is early this year. Decades early.
Mind the charts on your way past. Those pins are older than I am.
He hasn't slept in two days. He says the currents feel wrong.
He's usually right. That's the annoying part.
Go through, he's expecting you. Mind the charts, the pins are ancient.
And if you can get him to eat anything on your way out, I'll owe you.
I've been trying since Tuesday.

r1_walker: Six hours out, six hours back, and one interesting rock to show for it.
Ashgate's north if you stay on the spine road and don't get clever.

lines: You felt it too, then. Ground went quiet about an hour back.
Birds left first. They always do.
Get to Ashgate. Somebody there will want to hear it from you and not me.
Stay out of the deep grass until that one of yours has some weight on it.
Nothing on this route will kill you. Plenty of it will embarrass you.
And watch the pond at dusk. Only at dusk. Don't ask me why, I've stopped asking.
Go and see Vess. I'll be right behind you.
Obviously I'll be right behind you. I've been up since four.
